name: Chianciano Terme (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chianciano Terme (a star on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Chianciano Terme, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 7 February 1980.

features.role: Chianciano Terme arms — star on red, crowned, within branches
